description: This Kotlin source file defines the PlayerActivity class for an Android TV video player app. It manages fullscreen playback UI, handles back navigation (both system back button and hardware back key), and initializes the PlayerFragment with intent extras.

classes.name: PlayerActivity
classes.description: An activity that hosts the PlayerFragment for fullscreen video playback, managing back navigation and logging.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, starts the PlayerFragment, and registers back navigation callback.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles hardware back key to finish activity.
